subject: How can i model this conditional probability in Stan? (need some hints)

messages.author: aa5a92076f4ff4be
messages.subject: How can i model this conditional probability in Stan? (need some hints)
parts:
Dear all,

I'm a beginner in Stan and I have a problem in applying this toy example in Stan.
I would gratefully appreciate it if you could help me out in this regard.

In the level of detail in my question: Let's say P(x | g<0) is my target distribution. g = B - ((1/√n) * Σ xi) , where B = 3 , n (problem dimension) = 1000 and xi or x   have a standard normal distribution.

How can i model this target distribution in Stan? Is it doable?

I already tried Importance Sampling and Metropolis-Hasting methods but, I'm really interested in applying this in Stan as well to compare the results.
Understanding this toy example helps me a lot in my research.

Thank you very much in advance for your consideration.

Regards,
Hamed
